canonical_project: Digital Realty Athens Data Center Campus (ATH1-3, Koropi)
notes: Athens campus at Koropi/Kropia: three data centers, ~10.6k m2 colocation space, 70+ cloud/network providers, 135+ customers (official pages A). Lamda Hellix acquired by Digital Realty in 2020 - legacy brand deduped under Digital Realty. ATH3 recorded separately; ATH1/2 are legacy operational facilities.
